issues.legal_issue: A challenged eviction order may be modified to implement a consensual arrangement for partial surrender of the rented premises.
material_facts: The dispute concerned eviction under the rent-control statute after the tenant had built a large house and moved there, while another member of the joint family remained in the rented premises.

The lower courts differed on whether the new house, which was found to belong to the tenant individually rather than to the joint family, gave the family member remaining in the rented premises a right to accommodation there.
The parties, through counsel, consented to an arrangement under which the tenant would retain half the premises and surrender the other half after a partition was made.

The arrangement provided for equal sharing of the partition cost, continued payment of the full rent and charges, use of necessary facilities, and a first offer to the tenant if the surrendered portion were later relet.
issues.conclusion: The Court modified the High Court's eviction order to give effect to the parties' consent and undertakings: the tenant was to retain half the premises and surrender the other half after partition, on the agreed terms.
issues.legal_principle: The Court referred to the eviction ground in Section 13(1)(l) of the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947, and to the exercise of jurisdiction under Article 136 in the interests of justice. It did not resolve the competing interpretations of the statutory eviction ground; instead, it made directions based on the parties' consent and undertakings, which were enforceable as such. No earlier cases were relied on.

predicates.eviction_appeal: A tenant appealed an order directing eviction in a rent-control proceeding.
predicates.parties_agreed_to_partial_surrender: The landlord and tenant agreed that the tenant would retain part of the rented premises and surrender the remainder.
predicates.parties_undertook_partition_terms: The parties, through counsel, undertook terms governing partition, its cost, the tenant's continuing payments and use of facilities, and a first offer if the surrendered portion were relet.

issues.definition: When a tenant appeals an eviction order and the parties agree and undertake terms for partial surrender and partition of the rented premises, the order is modified to reflect their agreed arrangement.
